Three bands moved on the registered per-group surface (rule 24, on-registry; no off-registry channel, no price adder, no pinning): CC_REGULAR econ_low 1.0->0.96 (the fixed margin firmed CC's efficient low-load offer ~$1/MWh too high at below-anchor gas, pricing CC out of merit -> C1 CC_REGULAR 2023 316.8->319.1 TWh PASS) and CT_PEAKER econ_low 1.05->1.25 / econ_high 1.27->1.65 (firms the CT part-load offer to curb the high-gas 2025 CT over-run -> C1 CT_PEAKER 2025 32.0->30.6 TWh PASS). governance.note: Delta vs the pjm-117 net-revenue-margin keeper is the offer_curve_by_group re-level ONLY (3 bands: CC_REGULAR econ_low; CT_PEAKER econ_low + econ_high). Same structure, same anchor, zero NEW free parameters (the offer_curve_by_group DOF is unchanged; its levels moved within the rule-1 tuning phase). governance.residuals_note: Level retune CLOSES the C1 fuel-mix misses (CC_REGULAR all years PASS incl. 2023 fixed; CT_PEAKER all years PASS incl. 2025 fixed). The C3a 2025 mean-LMP miss (-10.5%) and the C3c scarcity-tail miss are OPEN STRUCTURAL MISSES, not offer-level ones, and are NOT logged as attestation exceptions (determination stays NOT-YET). A four-run offer-level sweep this session (pjm-118 lane: baseline + candidates A/B/C/D) PROVES the 2025 price miss cannot be closed on the offer surface: it is a SUMMER-scarcity under-pricing (model-vs-actual monthly LMP: Jan -1.0/Feb -2.1 but Jun -19.9/Jul -9.8/Sep -8.1/Oct -6.5 $/MWh), and the model's price tail caps at $324 (48 h > $100) against real 2025 summer scarcity (59 h > $200). Raising CC econ_high lifts 2025 price but BREAKS C1 CC 2023 (firms CC in low-gas hours, -7.5 TWh); lowering CC econ_low fixes C1 but FLOODS 2025 CC and lowers price (-11.0%); raising CC-peak + CT offers is INERT on 2025 (moved +0.02 $/MWh; tail p99 82.6->84.6, unchanged) because the marginal unit in the undershooting hours is not a peaker. Root cause: too much cheap supply (margin-compressed high-gas gas offers + imports) meets summer peaks, so scarcity never forms -> a STRUCTURAL supply-adequacy / scarcity-formation issue (rule 1: the real root cause, found not faked with an adder). Opens the PJM structural lane (summer scarcity / import-seam pricing); offer-level tuning for PJM is at frontier. No lever tuned to any PRICE residual (rules 1/11/13); the CC/CT re-level targets the C1 dispatch residual on the sanctioned offer DOF.
